title: release-triage-kudos-and-open-asks
body:
Release Triage — Weekly sync (notes + action list)
Date: 2025-03-04
Owner / scribe: Ava Chen
Attendees: Marcus Rivera, Priya Nair, Diego Alvarez, Mei Wong, Jordan Blake (SRE), Sam Ortiz (Platform)

Quick summary:
- Main focus this week: hotfix queue prioritization for 2025-03-05 patch window, investigation of a canary latency spike affecting the m-compat model variant, and validation steps for the rollout of dedicated-capacity autoscale policy v2.
- Decision snapshot: postpone v2 autoscale rollout by 48 hours pending KV-cache regression assessment; apply a targeted hotfix to us-west-2 pool to revert kernel selection change introduced in PR #978.

Highlights / context:
- Canary anomaly: On 2025-03-02 23:12 UTC a canary cohort (m-compat quantized-8) showed median p50 latency +85ms and p99 +420ms for small prompts (<64 tokens). Traces indicate higher memory churn in KV cache and extra GC cycles on the host process. Root cause likely a kernel selector change that increased temporary buffer allocations under certain sequence-length distributions.
- Impact: Affects ~4% of canary traffic, no customer-facing errors, but violates our p99 SLO for the canary.
- Hotfix target: revert the kernel selector flag for affected instances in us-west-2 serving pool and roll forward after additional stress tests.

Metrics snapshot (end of week):
- us-west-2 GPU pool utilization: 72% (weekday peak 92%)
- Hotfix queue length: 5 critical / 12 high / 7 medium
- Canary pass rate (last 7d): 96.1% -> current dip to 92.0% on 03-02
- Release train cadence: weekly train on Thursdays, next train: 2025-03-06 (t-minus 2 days)

Open items & decisions from meeting:
1) KV-cache kernel revert (DECISION): apply revert on 2025-03-05 02:00-03:00 UTC to us-west-2 canaries only, verify latency metrics for 30min, then expand to remaining canaries. (Owner: Marcus Rivera, due: 2025-03-05 01:30 UTC)
2) Autoscale v2 hold (DECISION): pause rollout until integration test shows <1% increase in tail latency. (Owner: Priya Nair, due: 2025-03-06 18:00 UTC)
3) Hotfix scheduling: patch window confirmed 2025-03-05 02:00-06:00 UTC. SRE on-call rotation: Jordan Blake -> lead; Mei Wong -> rollback lead. (Owner: Jordan Blake, due: 2025-03-05 01:00 UTC)
4) Post-deploy smoke checklist update: add KV-cache memory delta checks and a small prompt perf suite (50 samples) to the automated smoke run. (Owner: Diego Alvarez, due: 2025-03-05 23:59 UTC)
5) Communication: Draft customer note for any potential latency blips for enterprise customers with reserved capacity. Keep messaging conservative — low impact, proactive patching. (Owner: Sam Ortiz, due: 2025-03-05 09:00 UTC)

Blockers / risks:
- Risk: If kernel revert fails to restore expected latency, we may need a model-variant fallback (switch traffic to m-stable-1) which will increase cost by ~12% for affected routes. Need contingency budget signoff.
- Risk: High pool utilization (92% at peak) limits ability to move traffic during hotfix; coordinate with capacity team to free up a 1-2 GPU node buffer. (Action: Ping infra capacity channel; Owner: Mei Wong)

Kudos & notes to the team:
- Kudos to Priya for catching the odd correlation between sequence-length histogram and the latency bump in the canary dashboard. That diagnostic saved us hours of blind triage.
- Appreciation to the canary ops volunteers who stayed late to reproduce the regression in staging (Jordan, Mei).

Action items (concise):
- Marcus Rivera: Prepare and test kernel revert patch; schedule canary apply (due 2025-03-05 01:30 UTC).
- Priya Nair: Run autoscale v2 integration suite and post results; recommend hold/release (due 2025-03-06 18:00 UTC).
- Jordan Blake: Lead hotfix window and coordinate SRE on-call; own rollback playbook execution if needed (due 2025-03-05 06:00 UTC).
- Diego Alvarez: Update smoke checklist + add small-prompt perf suite; verify automation triggers (due 2025-03-05 23:59 UTC).
- Sam Ortiz: Draft customer comms for enterprise reserved customers; run by legal if needed (due 2025-03-05 09:00 UTC).
- Mei Wong: Coordinate capacity buffer and confirm GPU node availability in us-west-2 (due 2025-03-05 00:30 UTC).

Follow-ups for next sync (2025-03-06):
- Post-hotfix telemetry review (p50/p95/p99 across canary cohorts).
- Decide on autoscale v2 rollout plan (full rollout / staged / rollback).
- Review hotfix backlog and reprioritize remaining 12 high items for the next two sprint trains.

Notes to self / collisions to avoid (informal):
- If rolling kernel revert, ensure kernel-compat tests include quantized path permutations (q4/q8) — we nearly missed q4 edge-case last time.
- Double-check PR #978 changeset to avoid reintroducing allocation pattern.

Appendix (quick refs):
- Trace sample id: trace-20250302-2312-azWf (attached to GitHub PR comments)
- Related tickets: RELENG-1123 (canary regression), RELENG-1148 (autoscale v2 validation), RELENG-1155 (hotfix scheduling)

End of notes.
